== Summary ==
Cards and products spread on a table at the [[2009 World Championship]] (Clarion Hotel, Princeton, New Jersey, October 2009), posted on 12 October 2009. No one is named.

== Source ==
Posted on the Players Committee forum by The Smoking Gungan: [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=470144#p470144 post 470144], "Pics [Worlds 09]" (topic 31192), 12 October 2009. Photobucket album thepityofmrt, image DSC00407.jpg. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261105005202/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t31192.html Internet Archive]
* '''Watermark:''' This copy carries the Groupsy/Photobucket watermark that Photobucket stamped on re-served images; no unwatermarked copy was found (the Photobucket album is no longer public).
